title: The Broken Vow
logline: An exiled monk broke their vows to hide a heretical text, and now needs a pilot to fight off a crusader frigate sent to burn the archive.

roles.description: Old, serene, completely at peace with their impending death.
Zealous, armored, views all doubt as treason.
A crumbling orbital library filled with ancient scrolls.
A massive warship painted in the holy colors of the order.
A fanatical religious sect that controls the sector's history.

public_situation: The {role:holy_order} has declared the {role:sacred_archive} a heretical site and ordered it cleansed by orbital fire.
private_truth: The monk discovered a text proving the holy order was founded by a notorious pirate, and the captain is trying to destroy the evidence.

beats.public_change: The crusader frigate arrives in the system, broadcasting prayers of purification.

missions.reason: The captain hires the pilot to scan the archive to locate the exact position of the heretical text so they can target the orbital strike.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the text is shielded by the monastery's old but powerful shield grid.

beats.public_change: Gravity tides spike, making precision targeting impossible and forcing the frigate to move closer.

missions.reason: The monk begs the pilot to dock at the archive and collect the heretical text to save it from the fire.
missions.private_fact: The monk refuses to leave, stating they must burn with the archive to atone for their broken vows.

beats.public_change: The crusader frigate arms its main cannons, preparing to incinerate the entire library.

missions.reason: The monk pays the pilot everything they have to destroy the frigate and ensure the text escapes the system.
missions.private_fact: The captain hails the pilot, demanding they hand over the text and surrender, promising a quick, painless death.

player_choice.prompt: The frigate is heavily damaged. The pilot holds the heretical text. The captain demands surrender.

options.label: Finish off the frigate and escape with the text
Surrender the text to the captain

resolutions.summary: The frigate is destroyed. The pilot escapes with the text, exposing the holy order's fraudulent origins. The monk burns with the archive, a martyr to the truth.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot fought off a fanatic crusade to save a heretical text proving a religion was a lie.

resolutions.summary: The pilot hands over the text. The captain incinerates it, then destroys the archive and the monk. The pilot is spared but haunted by their cowardice.
The frigate incinerates the archive. The monk and the text are reduced to ash, and the holy order's secret remains safe forever.

loose_threads.detail: The notorious pirate who founded the holy order actually stole all their initial wealth from a lost colonial vault.
The monk admits they didn't just find the text; they actually wrote it, having discovered the truth decades ago.

radio_hooks: {role:holy_order} declares the sector cleansed of heresy.

voice_direction.crusader_captain: Loud, booming, speaks like they are addressing an army.
